author.title: One person, and someone who ships
author.subtitle: This is Sergey Sidorov's personal LMS — built solo, to teach the craft of project management in modern conditions.
author.name: Sergey Sidorov
author.role: Founder · project lead and product manager
author.bio: A professional in project management and IT product development. Much of his career was spent on flagship projects at Kaspersky Lab. He built this school himself, from the ground up, to pass on what actually works — planning, delivery, stakeholder and team leadership, and working with modern, AI-assisted tools. He removes uncertainty, drives initiatives to completion, and designs systems that survive production.

1.question: Who is this for?
1.answer: Project managers, product managers, systems analysts, and other product-team roles who want practical skills — not certificates for their own sake.

2.question: Do I need a project management background already?
2.answer: No single background is required — courses are practical and built for people already doing the work, whatever stage they're at. Check each course's description before enrolling.

3.question: How are courses delivered?
3.answer: Self-paced on the platform: chapters and lessons with text, images, video, and audio, with progress tracked as you go.

4.question: Can I suggest a topic?
4.answer: Yes. Email support{'@'}pmi.moscow — we keep every request, and new courses can be shaped by what people actually ask for.

5.question: Who runs this school?
5.answer: One person so far — Sergey Sidorov. See the instructor section and s-sidorov.ru.

6.question: How do I enrol?
6.answer: Sign in with your PMI Club or Google account, open a course and start — there's no separate checkout.

7.question: Is this a company?
7.answer: No — it's Sergey Sidorov's personal project, not a company. Read more about him at s-sidorov.ru.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: High Managers School uses only the browser data required for secure sign-in and a consistent experience. We do not use advertising, analytics or profiling cookies.
cookies.image_alt: Abstract browser panels, a security shield and small data tokens
cookies.cookies_intro: These first-party cookies are required to sign you in, protect the authentication flow and provide access to account-only features.

cookie_records.name: leanforge_api
cookie_records.purpose: Keeps you signed in and authorizes access to your account, courses and other protected features. This secure, HttpOnly cookie is not available to browser scripts.

cookie_records.name: LeanForgeTempCookie
cookie_records.purpose: Temporarily completes sign-in through PMI Club or Google. It is removed when authentication finishes.

cookie_records.name: Sign-in security cookies
cookie_records.purpose: Protect external sign-in against request forgery and replay attacks. They are removed after the provider returns you to the Service.

cookies.storage_intro: These preferences are stored locally on your device, are not sent with web requests and remain until you clear site data.

storage_records.name: Appearance
storage_records.purpose: Remembers your light or dark theme.

storage_records.name: Language
storage_records.purpose: Remembers whether the interface is displayed in Russian or English.

storage_records.name: Workspace layout
storage_records.purpose: Remembers the state of navigation panels available in your account.

blocks.text: The Service does not use browser analytics, advertising networks, social-media trackers or profiling cookies. There are no optional cookie categories to accept or reject.

PMI Club and Google process external sign-in on their own websites. Robokassa processes payments on its hosted checkout. These providers may use cookies on their domains under their own policies; High Managers School does not control them.
Their pages, analytics scripts and social widgets are not embedded in this website.
Logging out removes your session cookie. You can also delete cookies and local storage through your browser's site-data settings.
Blocking essential cookies prevents sign-in. Clearing local storage resets interface preferences but does not delete your account or course data.

cookies.contact_text: If you have a question about cookies or browser storage used by the Service, contact us.
